crossRefs.note: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”
translations.bsb: And Saul commanded his servants, “Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me.”
translations.kjv: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.
translations.asv: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.
